name: twiligent
description: Self-hosted social media analytics and publishing dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace site
scripts.test: npm test --workspace backend && npm test --workspace frontend && npm test --workspace site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace site && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:schema: supabase db schema declarative generate --linked --schema public --overwrite --yes
